script: function(context is Context, queries) { var bodies = qAllModifiableSolidBodies(); var box = evBox3d(context, {"topology": bodies, "tight": true}); return {"solidCount": size(evaluateQuery(context, bodies)), "volume_mm3": evVolume(context, {"entities": bodies}) / millimeter^3, "min_mm": box.minCorner / millimeter, "max_mm": box.maxCorner / millimeter, "partIds": transientQueriesToStrings(evaluateQuery(context, bodies))}; }
